svg.title: Audit log containers, scenario x10
svg.text: a listing or account was blocked
UI for staff and organization admins: admin actions and audit log search
Emit an audit event per action
Parquet by date and hash digests.
Scenario x10: 10M events per day, peak ~1,160 events/s, ~10 GB per day.
Hot data: last 30 days (~300 GB) in the audit DB. Archive: 5 years in S3 (~18 TB raw, ~2-3.5 TB as Parquet).
Event path: domain transaction, outbox, relay, ingestion, audit DB, archive. At-least-once, deduplicated by event_id.
Immutability: INSERT-only role and append-only trigger in the audit DB; S3 Object Lock (compliance) and hourly hash digests in the archive.
